title: Ridon: GenCorp P2.14M paid to VP Duterte faces closer scrutiny
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The P2.14 million allegedly paid by GenCorp Industries Inc. to Vice President Sara Z. Duterte will face further scrutiny, Rep. Terry Ridon, a House impeachment prosecutor, said…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P2.14 million allegedly paid by GenCorp Industries Inc. to Vice President Sara Z. Duterte will face further scrutiny, Rep. Terry Ridon, a House impeachment prosecutor, said in a statement on Monday. Ridon said it would have to be decided whether additional records could establish the legal basis of the monthly payments and whether they could be properly considered by the Senate impeachment court. He raised this concern as he noted that the testimony of GenCorp corporate counsel Suzette Balucanag-Punay left unresolved questions about the company’s continuing payments to Duterte when she was already vice president. “They have not […]...
